page.layout: One page of text in verse, one block, with a running head above and a page number and signature at the foot. Margin marks on the right are ornaments and show-through, not notes.

main_text.l: Et thure multo non meum quaerat lubens
Edicta solus: quaeque cuncta gens probat
Quidquam graue, licet dura mandet sapius.
Nam iussus ad arduum Moriia verticem
Montis suum mox mox Isacum ducere.
Nato timentis lacrymas haud movent, neque
Dura mala quae senes solent orbos sequi.
Sed quidquid accidat, meis hac commodis
Res cedet ultro. Namque si nihil pauens
Nequibit illud, regna quod vertet mea,
Mortisque ahena vincla rumpens pallida, Et

page.notes: Long s is printed as s throughout. Several words are doubtful, marked [?]. Decorative capital forms such as the Vllas and Vnus initials are read as V. The final line is partly unclear. Running head is in capitals as printed.
